links.comparator_used: LLM's verbalized self-rated confidence (expressed confidence rated 0 to 100)
links.outcome: Discrimination of response accuracy (AUROC) across 9 LLMs on USMLE MedQA questions
links.effect: Response token probability AUROCs ranged from 0.71 (95% CI 0.69-0.73) for Phi-3-Mini to 0.87 (95% CI 0.85-0.89) for GPT-4o, versus expressed confidence AUROCs of 0.52 (95% CI 0.50-0.53) for Phi-3-Mini to 0.68 (95% CI 0.65-0.71) for GPT-4o; all P<.001
links.tradeoff: All models still showed imperfect calibration with a general trend toward overconfidence.
links.quote: In contrast, the response token probability consistently outperformed expressed confidence for predicting response accuracy (AUROCs ranging from 0.71, 95% CI 0.69-0.73 for Phi-3-Mini to 0.87, 95% CI 0.85-0.89 for GPT-4o; all P<.001).

design_hint: token probability-based confidence signal vs self-reported confidence
